requirements.R1: Find the 5 most-starred open-source multi-agent frameworks on GitHub.
requirements.R2: Get each one's star count from the GitHub API.
requirements.R3: Get each one's latest release date from the GitHub API.
requirements.R4: Put the data in a spreadsheet.
requirements.R5: Make a chart based on the data.
requirements.R6: Write a 2-page Word report with citations.

givens: assumption: "Multi-agent frameworks" will be identified using GitHub search queries (e.g., "multi-agent framework", "AI agents") and filtered by star count.
assumption: "Spreadsheet" refers to an .xlsx or .csv file.
assumption: "Chart" refers to a visual representation of star counts (e.g., bar chart).
assumption: "Word report" refers to a .docx file.
assumption: "Citations" refer to the source URLs of the GitHub repositories.

open_questions.question: Which specific GitHub search terms define "multi-agent framework"?
open_questions.assumption: Use a combination of "multi-agent" and "agent framework" topics, sorted by stars.

roles.name: OS Intelligence Analyst
roles.goal: Provide a verified list of the top 5 multi-agent frameworks with their star counts and release dates.

outputs.format: table: Name | Stars | Latest Release Date | URL

success_criteria: Star counts and dates are current as of the API call

roles.name: Data Visualization Engineer
roles.goal: Produce a professional spreadsheet and a corresponding star-count chart.
inputs: Framework Data Table from OS Intelligence Analyst
success_criteria: Spreadsheet contains all 5 frameworks and their metrics
Chart clearly shows the relative popularity of the frameworks

roles.name: Technical Writer
roles.goal: Write a comprehensive 2-page Word report analyzing the top frameworks.
success_criteria: Report is exactly or approximately 2 pages

roles.name: Delivery Lead
roles.goal: Verify all deliverables and email them to the client.
success_criteria: All 3 files are attached to the email
Data in files matches API data exactly
Email sent to the correct address

roles.name: Project Summariser
roles.goal: Confirm all deliverables have been sent and requirements met.
success_criteria: Clear confirmation that the email was sent with all 3 attachments

requests.name: github_api_tool
requests.what_it_does: Searches GitHub repositories and fetches specific repo metadata (stars, releases).
requests.output: JSON response with stargazers_count and latest release date

requests.name: spreadsheet_tool
requests.what_it_does: Creates an Excel (.xlsx) file from a provided data table.

requests.name: chart_tool
requests.what_it_does: Generates a chart image (.png) from numerical data.
requests.input: Labels and values for the chart

requests.name: word_doc_tool
requests.what_it_does: Creates a formatted Word (.docx) document from text/markdown.
requests.input: Formatted text and page length requirements

requests.name: email_tool
requests.what_it_does: Sends an email with attachments to a specified address.
requests.input: Recipient, subject, body, and list of file paths
